**Round 445: PASS.** I found no bugs, and `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. I did not claim the gate rows (full vitest, typecheck, build, Biome, verify), and I ran no vitest beyond the covering set.

I ran everything in real Chromium on `http://127.0.0.1:5173/studio-lab` at 1440×900 and 1280×720. The source stayed read-only, and the tree held exactly the 13 granted paths at start and end.

- **Scope and identity:** the 10 sketch files are byte-identical to B's copies. The claims script output matches B's expected output exactly.
- **Held Escape with the video expanded (C5):** the tree gives `ALL OK (14 cells)` and `FRESH ALL SAME (14 cells)`. HEAD, run on a separate port as a control, gives `NOT ALL OK (8 of 14 failing)`, on the same cells as B's baseline. This also closes GATE443-L1: the Clip Gain and Library-search cells leave the video expanded on both tree and HEAD, so there is no user-visible effect.
- **Neighbours:** the three earlier IME probes each give `ALL OK (18 cells)`. The plain held-key probe gives `ALL SAME (18 cells)` against HEAD.
- **Smoke and auth:** an anonymous visit has `auth_user` null. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with 0 `audio[src]`, and the studio token request returns 401, so premium auth is not bypassed. Play reaches Playing and Stop returns to Stopped at both viewports.
- **Covering tests:** 60 files and 1082 of 1082 tests pass.
- **Mutants:** 12 results, and each id, return code and failing rows equal B's `results.jsonl`.
- **Docs:** docs 288, 289 and 290 have the exact status line, doc 290 has the TEMPLATE headings in order, and no "C round N pending" lines remain.

One SHEET cell at 1440 returned a cold-start `error` in both the tree run and the HEAD run. I re-ran it each time and it passed, as the task allows.

**Blocked:** TLM-SYS3-IME-PLATFORMS needs a real OS IME, macOS Option or Android, which the cloud can't test. It is a Tech Lead manual check with a deadline of RETRO 450. I did not measure the audio graph or export WAV because this round only changes key handling.

Everything is under `tmp/studio-real-loop/`. Start with `c-round-445.md` and `c-round-445.json`, which passes `l57-check.py` with "L57 OK"; the evidence is in `c-round-445/`.
